_doc: scripts.aerial.engine config for Pikes Peak International Raceway's road course (ledger 0088; the route and pieces of ledger 0085, re-derived by the engine). Data only: the files, the maps' ink colours, label and S/F pixels read off the published maps, the pit lanes they draw in the course colour (exclude_px), the published direction and lengths. Imagery, maps and Kevin's sketch are not committed (PPIR_NAIP, PPIR_MAPS, PPIR_SKETCH); their sidecars are.
name: Pikes Peak International Raceway
